blocks.text: Year after year, Avignon Clinic has continued to earn recognition at the Tala Awards—establishing a track record of consistency, clinical expertise and excellence in aesthetic care. Presented by Merz Aesthetics Philippines, the Tala Awards 2026 recognize aesthetic providers for their performance and expertise in delivering leading aesthetic technologies and treatments. Avignon’s repeated recognition over the years has become an important part of its brand journey—reflecting not only its investment in advanced technologies, but the competence of the people leading them. For Dr. Christine Chio, Avignon Clinic Medical Director, each recognition represents the collective effort of the Avignon team—from doctors and aesthetic […]...
